claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Flecainide at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen; its known pharmacology is use-dependent block of cardiac sodium channels (Nav1.5) and ryanodine receptor inhibition, neither of which produces cytotoxicity in proliferating cancer cell lines at this concentration.
